description: The file implements a Node.js script serving as an MCP proxy, which processes command-line arguments, decodes payloads, and spawns a child process while rerouting and injecting certain data into the communication streams.

methods.name: decodePayload
methods.description: Decodes and validates a base64url-encoded JSON payload from command-line arguments, ensuring required fields are present.

methods.name: shouldInject
methods.description: Determines whether a given method name warrants modification of its parameters.

methods.name: rewriteLine
methods.description: Attempts to parse a line as JSON and injects mcpServers into specific method calls if applicable.

methods.name: isMainModule
methods.description: Checks whether the current script is the main module being executed.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution logic that sets up child process spawn, stream handling, and process events.
